scope: Card 58: edge-only claims, design writes and controller caches; per-tick structure polling removed; PER_CELL comparison recorded but not enabled
source: New implementation against the local card contract; no third-party source, assets or dependencies imported
implementation: PartBindings stores position-to-role and updates per cell: unchanged role plus a live derived part cache skips bind; new, changed or recreated parts bind; removed cells release and restore their design
ClaimMemory deleted; StructureClaims.update now returns APPLIED only when a cell was bound or released, UNCHANGED otherwise
StructureDesigns compares the current gt.design per cell and writes only when it differs
Incremental evaluation skips applyStructure/applyIncompleteStructure when already formed and the evaluation touched no cell

Edge callbacks moved to TrackedMultiblock.onStructureFormed/onStructureBroken, dispatched together with structureFormedChanged by StructureTracking.formedChanged; the unused StructureDefinition hooks were removed
Fifteen controller families read an edge-maintained formed bit in their tick; the legacy rollback still scans on query
Large recipe machines cache condition energy parts on the formed edge instead of walking bindings every tick
StructureScanProbe counts real design writes and tracked structure queries for the idle assertions
release_order_unchanged: claim release, controller/role clear, crucible visual reset, design restore

scenarios.safety_rescan: safetyRescanDoesNotBindOrMarkChunks now also asserts zero design writes and an unsaved part chunk
scenarios.design_edges: designWritesFollowTheEdgeAndTheReplacedCell: forming edge writes 5/6; idle rescan binds, releases and writes nothing; NBT saved before and after an idle rescan compares equal; replacing one cell rebinds and rewrites only that cell; a break restores the design
scenarios.tick_queries: formedControllersTickWithoutStructureQueries: 100 ticks of implosion, gas turbine and behavior machine with zero structure queries and zero scans

not_done: PER_CELL runtime enabling was not implemented by user decision: every family keeps ATOMIC; logistics core keeps its declaration but claimPolicy() has no runtime consumer
No client launch or manual play test; verification is the merged GameTest run plus the existing controller regressions
No saved-world restart test; the acceptance relies on the unchanged gt.design NBT keys and the before/after save comparison
Full default GameTest suites were not run on either platform; the card did not require them
decisions_recorded: docs/integration/DECISIONS.md, 2026-10-25 card 58 entry with the PER_CELL comparison
